notes: Phase 2.5 architectural stress test. TEST FIXTURE ONLY: it does not ship and no shipped manifest names it. It models a long-lived local model server that streams incremental token deltas, holds a resumable session, sends heartbeats and tool rounds, and sometimes ends without a terminal event. network_policy is none on purpose: Firebreak offers only unshare-net or the whole host network, so reaching a host loopback model server today would mean granting unfiltered internet, and the transport is therefore injected rather than real. See the adapter docstring.
